summary: All 25 SPEC items PASS. npm test 15/15 (8 files), lint/typecheck clean, the clean-clone SPEC-22 chain passes end to end (12.4 s), e2e has 10 passed in Chromium and WebKit, and the injected a11y violation fails both projects with image-alt (critical). Independent probes: exhaustive 4,584-combination boundary lint, extra bypasses, warning-only lint, typecheck scope (tests/e2e/tools), 88.88% headless coverage, axe severity filtering and format, dev and preview pages in both browsers, and busy-port fail-fast. Mutation probes showed each builder toolchain test fails when the config it guards is broken (strict, boundary, thresholds, prettier-in-lint, src discovery, global list). Timing is well within budgets. SPEC-07 uses the A-12 fixed probe. The SPEC-23 Backlog doc check waits for the Documentor step. No blocking findings.
